title: Simple Grade Calculator
description:
Create a function called calculate_final_grade that calculates a student's final score and grade based on their performance in assignments, midterm exam, final exam, and attendance. 
Requirements: The function should take the following parameters: 
>>> assignments (list of int): Scores from 0 to 100 
>>> midterm (int): Midterm exam score (0 to 100) 
>>> final_exam (int): Final exam score (0 to 100) 
>>> attendance (int): Attendance percentage (0 to 100) 

Weights: Assignments 40%, Midterm 20%, Final 30%, Attendance 10%. 

Grades: 
>>> 90-100='A', 
>>> 80-89='B', 
>>> 70-79='C', 
>>> 60-69='D', 
>>> Below 60='F'. 
Special rules: 
>>> If final_exam < 50, max grade 'C'; 
>>> If attendance < 70, max grade 'B'; 
>>> If assignments average, midterm, and final_exam > 95, grade='A+'. 
Edge cases: 
>>> Negative or > 100 return 'Invalid score'; 
>>> Empty assignments return 'No assignment scores provided'. 
Return format(string): 
'score is <score>, grade is <grade> and passed'.

title: Shopping Cart Price Calculator
